label: Impact-landform observation
support_reason: NASA and LROC sources document impact-related landforms, blocks, crater textures, and feature interpretation at the selected scopes.
limitations: This supports observation practice only; it does not validate scientific equivalence or field safety.

label: Robotic mapping
support_reason: NASA documents field mapping and rover-access work at Haughton, while LROC provides a mapped Shackleton rim view for traverse planning.
limitations: Earth operations do not reproduce lunar gravity, vacuum, lighting, or communication conditions.

label: Traverse planning
support_reason: The paired sources describe bouldered or blocky terrain and access or traverse interpretation at each feature scope.
limitations: No matched slope, obstacle-density, route-clearance, or landing-site analysis has been completed.

label: Shoreline and terrace mapping
support_reason: NASA documents exposed Salda shoreline deposits and terraces and a possible ancient-shoreline context at Jezero.
limitations: This supports comparative observation only; feature footprints and physical scales are not matched, and it is not an approved Mars field plan.

label: Carbonate and sediment observation
support_reason: Published Salda observations describe hydromagnesite-rich sediments while NASA identifies possible carbonate-bearing Jezero margin material.
limitations: Jezero mineral identification is tentative; do not infer identical mineralogy or biological origin.

label: Delta and depositional-landform mapping
support_reason: USGS identifies the San Pedro delta and NASA documents the Jezero delta front and sedimentary outcrops.
limitations: The Earth site is an ephemeral delta entering a saline salar; no matched footprint, scale, or route suitability is established.

label: Sedimentary outcrop observation
support_reason: The sources document Earth alluvial/delta deposits and Mars fine-grained layered delta sediments.
limitations: This is a research practice analogy only; material chemistry differs and no field activity is approved.

label: Alluvial-fan mapping
support_reason: USGS and Palucis et al. map named alluvial fans and describe channels and sediment deposition at both sites.
limitations: Whole-fan sizes differ substantially; no matched subarea, slope, or safe-traverse assessment is available.

label: Alluvial sediment observation
support_reason: The sources describe coarse-to-fine terrestrial fan sediment and mapped Martian fan deposits.
limitations: Source lithology and mineralogy are not demonstrated to match.
